sql: SELECT m.id, m.event, m.round, m.winner, w.name AS winner_name, m.loser, l.name AS loser_name, m.score, m.status FROM matches m LEFT JOIN players w ON w.id=m.winner LEFT JOIN players l ON l.id=m.loser WHERE m.event=%s AND ((m.winner=%s AND m.loser=%s) OR (m.winner=%s AND m.loser=%s))
